# Muse Job Hunter

A pipeline board for your whole job search: every role is a card with a fit score, a queue your Muse works through, key contacts with follow-up dates, and outreach drafts you approve and send yourself. It learns your answers as applications come up — parking anything it can't fill honestly instead of guessing — and once it knows them, it can apply on its own to roles that pass the gates you set. It starts completely empty and is generic, for any kind of job search.
